_note: ONEACT1 V1 (S568, owner: '1 action per player instead of 3 (increase beats)'): a beat is ONE action - a lead-hand punch, a rear-hand punch, a step, a push off, a clinch or nothing. 12 beats a round, stamina back 1 a beat and nothing for a held hand (N.rec 1, N.hold 0). What was 'later in this beat' pays on the NEXT beat: the counter after his miss or block (open), the feint (drawn), the pull counter (pull); the solver values them at W.open 0.3, W.drawn 0.6, W.pull 0.3. Nothing else changed. docs/ONEACT1_RESULT.md.
